name: twosystems
description: A cheap, honest watchman for Claude Code: asks before the next step when the agent seems stuck, suggests /clear or /compact when a fresh start would save tokens, and keeps a receipt of what it cost and saved. Created by Shashikant.

engine.title: Decision engine
engine.description: auto: OpenRouter when a key is set, otherwise rules. rules: no model, nothing leaves your machine. openrouter: Microsoft Decision-1 or TypeSafe Jev. ollama: a local decision model.

openrouter_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_key.description: Optional. Kept in your system's secure storage. Left empty, OPENROUTER_API_KEY from your environment is used if set.

model.title: Decision model
model.description: Empty for the default (microsoft/microsoft-decision-1-20261009 on OpenRouter). Another OpenRouter id such as typesafe/jev-1.14, or an Ollama model such as nimble.

ollama_host.title: Ollama address
ollama_host.description: Where Ollama runs, for the ollama engine.

false_alarm_budget.title: False-alarm level
false_alarm_budget.description: How readily twosystems interrupts. low is the most cautious. Until calibration ships, this moves the built-in thresholds; it is not yet a measured rate.

holdout.title: Holdout share
holdout.description: Share of suggestions held back on purpose so the receipt can measure what the shown ones saved. 0 to 0.5.

cache_minutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cache_minutes.description: 60 on a Claude plan. 5 with an API key or a cloud provider.

hold_new_task_prompts.title: Ask before a new task in a large conversation
hold_new_task_prompts.description: When a prompt looks like a different task and the conversation is large, hold it and offer Clear, Compact or Send as is.

receipt_line.title: Receipt line under answers
receipt_line.description: Show a short line under an answer when twosystems did something during that turn.

timeout_ms.title: Decision model timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Longest wait for the decision model before twosystems stays silent. 500 to 8000.
